offering_description.value: Leases outpatient medical facilities to healthcare providers under long-term agreements. It also invests in senior housing and works with national operators to manage those properties.

quotes.quote: At National Healthcare Properties, our success is fueled by our hands-on approach to asset management and the symbiotic relationship between complementary asset classes. High-quality outpatient medical facilities with creditworthy healthcare provider tenants generate consistent performance, while strong partnerships with top industry operators and our high-quality needs-based assets propel our growth in the thriving and supply-constrained senior housing market.

Our approach is tenant-friendly yet rent-focused, structuring competitive deals while remaining focused on renewals and maximizing rental income. With long-term leases, a stable credit tenant base and high retention, this asset class delivers predictable, resilient returns.
